facts.fact: 乔丹用尽全力把双腕撞向紧急出口的推杆，因为一头美洲豹正在身后追她。
facts.anchor: Jordan slammed her wrists against the push bar of the emergency door so hard, she thought they might break

facts.fact: 众人合力把门推到发出咔哒声关上，靠团队协作把美洲豹挡在门外。
facts.anchor: All of them, together, with all the power they had, that power magnified by teamwork

facts.fact: 米洛主张尽快赶回度假村，因为关住美洲豹的电力设施已被暴风雨破坏。
facts.anchor: “We need to get back to the resort and fast,” Milo finally managed to say

facts.fact: 马克斯和艾弗里开着两辆天堂度假村的高尔夫车从泥泞中赶来接应。
facts.anchor: Then suddenly two Paradise golf carts were there in the mud, Max and Avery behind their wheels

facts.fact: 重新分配座位时，乔丹坐上驾驶座，莉莉和萨姆挤进后座。
facts.anchor: Jordan got in the drivers’ seat while Lily and Sam piled into the back

facts.fact: 萨姆替莉莉说话，指出正是她坚持要回去找乔丹，劝乔丹别再苛责莉莉。
facts.anchor: Lily was the one who insisted we look for you back at the Feeding Frenzy

facts.fact: 路上出现一只长着红棕色皮毛和大鹿角的麋鹿，莉莉推测它是猎杀表演的猎物。
facts.anchor: On the service road in front of them was a majestic elk with reddish-brown fur and large antlers

facts.fact: 乔丹踩下油门，祈望能在再出意外前赶回度假村。
facts.anchor: Jordan slammed her foot on the gas and hoped that they could make it back to the resort before anything else went wrong
